solution._comment: AWS Solution identity: the single source of truth for both reporting mechanisms, the CloudFormation stack Description (deployment counting) and the AWS SDK User-Agent suffix (API usage attribution). The Description carries the primary id followed by each of 'secondary_ids'; the User-Agent carries only 'secondary_ids' (the primary id only if that list is empty). Not a per-run knob: bump 'version' when cutting a release and otherwise leave it alone. Read only by cdk/lib/solution.ts and pidtwin/src/pidtwin/solution.py, always from this file, never from cdk/config.json. See those two files for the exact formats.
solution.name: Guidance for Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams Digitization on AWS
